    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]

        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]

        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if (r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)) and out[r][c] == bg:
                out[r][c]=2
    return out
'''
